sources.note: Expert (volunteer Photobiology Committee) reviewed, but manufacturers apply and Corporate Council members pay fees: record as quality with that caveat. Only sunscreen/skin brands recorded; clothing, window film, shade, retailer own-labels (CVS, Walgreens, Target) skipped. Confirmed 43 known.
